workflow_and_state: code-seam@v2: THINKME -> TICKETME -> BUILDME -> PROVEME -> WATCHME(the_rehearsal_predicts_the_build) -> [PROVED]
owner: CC builds it; codemother owns the care of the code (the lane and sieve are inspector things); the rehearsal machine at cairn/machines/rehearsal/ is a machine with its charter beside it; rehearsal records in CairnCommons/rehearsals/ are records of truth gated by the artifact door.

watchme.trigger: every PROVED crossing on a ticket whose rehearsal field points at a clean record — the exit gate pokes the probe after journaling its verdict, so it costs nothing between crossings and no poller exists
watchme.enough: ten rehearsed tickets have reached PROVED and the divergence list is empty on at least eight of them — then the gate is trusted and the probe reports enough; fewer than eight is the WRONG-INTENT finding, carried back to this ticket
watchme.carrier: a verdict artifact against this ticket's falsifier: per ticket, the converged tree's steps, the built proof's teeth, and the diff both ways, written onto the rehearsal record
watchme.nexus: the rehearsal machine's state (state.json beside the code) and, once the child tree is cast, the rehearsal nexus that learns which gaps recur
watchme.consumer: CC at the next /sail on any ticket (the trusted-or-not reading is the first line of the rehearsal step); Akien only when the WRONG-INTENT finding fires

children: one, cast later and not now: 'the rehearsal nexus learns which gaps recur' — a learning block over the rehearsal records (gap kinds, decision kinds, the post-PROVED divergences) whose counsel at ticket-writing time asks the recurring questions before the first read. Cast after ten rehearsal records exist, because a tree trained on zero verdicts is the hollow learning the chart chain measured at 0.00; cited here so it cannot vanish into conversation.
